title: The Provenance Information of a Resource

ProvenanceDefinition.description: The provenance object used in all metadata files.

id.description: A urn that identifies the original resource that generated this metadata.

createdAt.description: The timestamp where the original resource was created

updatedAt.description: The timestamp where the original resource was updated

version.description: The version in the target system of this resource

status.description: The status of the resource in the origin system.

url.description: The url of the original resource.
